title: agentfs agent state
description: The document an agent writes to declare what it is doing. agentfs reads one of these per agent workspace directory. Members the contract does not define are preserved and ignored.

schema.description: The contract version the document declares.

status.description: The state the agent declares itself to be in.

agent.description: The agent's name. The workspace directory name is used when absent.

step.description: The position within the task: a non-negative ordinal or a named phase.

steps_total.description: The number of steps the task is expected to take.

model.description: The model the agent is running against.

run_id.description: The run directory this document belongs to.

problem.description: A fault description, independent of status.

heartbeat_seconds.description: How often the agent undertakes to rewrite the document. A document older than this is reported stale.

started_at.description: When the agent began the task, as an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.

updated_at.description: When the agent last wrote the document, as an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.
